newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Jan industrial output up 11.4 pct - FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Jan industrial output up 11.4 pct - FIEL.

text.p: Argentina's industrial production in January rose 11.4 percent from the same month a year earlier, the private consultancy FIEL said Wednesday.
Compared with December, industrial output was 14.5 percent lower, FIEL said.
FIEL said the fall in January from December was seasonal.
The figures are preliminary and FIEL will release a revision on Feb 24.
FIEL added that preliminary figures for all of 1996 showed an increase in the industrial production index of 5.1 percent from 1995.
"Hence, the level of industrial activity in 1996 would be higher than the 1995 level but would not reach the levels of 1994," FIEL said in a statement.
Industrial production in the fourth quarter of last year rose 11.9 percent from the same period in 1995.
December's production levels were 10.7 percent higher than in December 1995.
